event_file_compression: gzip -9; decompress to recover the exact CSV consumed by offline replays
event_retention_policy: events.csv is periodically flushed; only bridge timing rows are held in memory, and topic partitions are streamed from events.csv at close
ground_truth_file_status: packet_embedded_offline_diagnostic; no ground-truth ROS topic subscription and no runtime controller consumer

lidar_range_capture.encoding: little-endian float32, contiguous per indexed scan

source_time_policy: ROS sensor headers use the bridge host's ROS receive clock; packet arrival and request intervals use host monotonic time. No Unity simulation timestamp, frame, or physics-step field is required or consumed by runtime nodes. Such diagnostic fields remain null.
